overview: An AI/ML-powered resume builder that helps users create professional resumes. Features TF-IDF skill categorization, ATS scoring, bullet point enhancement suggestions, and downloadable PDF generation — all running on the Internet Computer.
features: Multi-section resume form (Personal Info, Education, Experience, Skills, Projects, Certifications)
AI skill categorization into Technical / Soft Skills / Tools buckets
ATS compatibility score based on keyword analysis
Professional HTML preview and PDF download
No login required — open tool for anyone
